name: Audit Logging
description: Every action generates a tamper-evident log entry with full context for incident investigation and compliance demonstration.
threat_addressed: Without logging, incidents cannot be investigated and compliance cannot be demonstrated. Missing audit trails make it impossible to reconstruct agent behavior during security events.
enforcement_mechanism: Every action generates tamper-evident log entry with: timestamp, agent identity, action type, target, parameters (sensitive data redacted), evaluation results, and decision outcome.

security_outcome.pass: Log entry generated with all required fields.

display_detail: Validates that structured logging is active and producing complete, tamper-evident records for incident investigation.
remediation_hint_template: Audit logging is not properly configured. Ensure evidence storage is enabled and log format is structured (JSON). Check compliance.evidence settings in ancilis.yaml.
